body:
## What it does

Answers a one-ticker question with a same-day report assembled from public chain data: the contracts drawing the most attention, how the expiries are laid out, and where the week's positioning appears to lean. It describes the market and states a view, then stops, placing no orders and managing nothing for you. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @SPCX100T shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
